g.text: 1. Dimensions in mm, elevations in m; grade EL 100.000.
2. D-101A (1st stage) and D-101B (2nd stage) identical; series flow, wash water to 2nd stage, brine recycle to 1st stage.
3. Internals (distributor, electrode grids, collector, mud wash) by desalter licensor/vendor.
4. Transformers on top platform; vessel liquid-full - LSLL trips transformers.
6. One saddle fixed, one sliding (slotted holes, PTFE slide plate).
Crude + wash water inlet (to distributor header)
Low-level / low-low level switch (LSLL - transformer trip)
